il-world-galilee.basis: Israel's five wine regions have no published admin-unit definition. Outlines follow Israeli districts inside the pre-1967 lines; the Golan Heights and the West Bank are not drawn.
il-world-galilee.outline: Built from the administrative units that contain the area. The legal boundary follows other lines (roads, rivers, farms or altitude), so the real area is smaller.
il-world-galilee.atlas_note: Israel's northern wine region, highest and coolest, including Upper Galilee.
